title: Bad_player's textures
description: PVP resource pack that Bad_player123 uses
body:
This resource pack is made by me (Bad_player123), I made it for PVP, because it looked kinda cool so I wanted to share somewhere public. I hope you will enjoy it :)

This resource pack features:
-low shield 
-low fire 
-2 mace variants (1 for density and 1 for breach), (in 1.21.4 or newer will this work without mods, but below 1.21.4 I would recomend downloading Cit resewn (1.21.1)
-and cool and clean weapon textures
-transparent explosion particles
and more...
